rules.name: registration-deposit-promotion
rules.reason: One pointerdown/click pair on the explicit close control; the matching registration/deposit promotion subsequently becomes hidden. No form inputs were present in the captured promotion.

rules.name: app-install-promotion
rules.reason: One pointerdown/click pair on this dialog's own close icon, followed by hidden state of the matching app-install dialog. Scope the common close selector to this exact container.

rules.name: promotional-carousel
rules.reason: Two actual close gestures, each recorded as pointerdown/click, close initial and reopened single-tab variants of the same promotional carousel. Both matching dialogs later become hidden. Body interactions 5/6 are not closing evidence.

rules.name: slash-wheel-promotion
rules.reason: Two close gestures on original and reopened versions of the same exact slash/wheel dialog; matching containers later become hidden. This rule does not include separately rendered prize-selection or verification dialogs.

rules.name: task-invitation-promotion
rules.reason: One pointerdown/click pair on the local close icon; the invitation/task promotion subsequently becomes hidden. Never activate its forward or series buttons.

rules.name: push-permission-promotion
rules.reason: One pointerdown/click pair explicitly targets the notification prompt's cancellation control. This element was outside the recorder's tracked popup list, so its after-snapshot visibility is not available; cancellation semantics and its exact captured ancestors identify it.

rules.name: find-us-install-promotion
rules.reason: One pointerdown/click pair on this exact find-us/download promotion's local close icon; its matching popup later becomes hidden.

rules.name: dismissible-floating-promotion
rules.reason: Four close gestures, each recorded as pointerdown/click, cover left/right scroll and swiper floating variants. Their matching entries/modules become hidden. Require the captured close image and target only that entry; do not blanket-hide all fast-entry-item modules or floating containers.

rules.name: captured-verification-close
rules.reason: Explicit native X closures included at the user's request; only dismiss the captured dialog, never answer or submit its contents.

protected.name: interactive-prize-selection
protected.reason: Recorded actions select a prize/draw item and open a verification dialog; they do not close this popup. Preserve the interactive reward flow and exclude its own assets from cosmetic-only blocking.

excludedInteractions.name: carousel-body-interaction
excludedInteractions.reason: Interaction occurs inside carousel content rather than its close image; not a separate closure or rule.

excludedInteractions.name: main-navigation
excludedInteractions.reason: Main tab navigation changes which page/floating modules are visible. Disappearing promotional nodes after navigation are not close controls.

excludedInteractions.name: floating-promotion-open
excludedInteractions.reason: Click targets the entry image, not its separate close image, and opens promotional content. Do not automate this click. Only explicitly dismissible entries qualify for the floating close rule.

excludedInteractions.name: event-tab-open
excludedInteractions.reason: Event-tab navigation/open action, not dismissal. Preserve the tab and its images.

scope: All explicit native close/cancel controls recorded in the capture, including the verification dialog.
